blocks.text: TimeCart ("Where Time Meets Style") is a premium watch e-commerce storefront. From the project README and source, it is built with Next.js 16 (App Router), Supabase (Postgres / Auth / Storage), Prisma 7, Tailwind CSS 4, and Recharts. It supports customer browsing, cart, checkout, order tracking and reviews, plus an admin area for products, coupons, customers and orders.

items: Frontend and API: Next.js 16 App Router (evidence: package.json, src/app).
Database engine: relational Postgres via Supabase (evidence: prisma/schema.prisma, datasource db).
Authentication: Supabase Auth with custom middleware (evidence: src/middleware.ts, src/lib/session.ts).
Email delivery: Resend (evidence: package.json dependency + usage).

blocks.text: The relational schema is defined in prisma/schema.prisma as a Postgres database with 23 models (e.g. User, Profile, Product, Order, OrderItem, Payment, Review, Coupon) and 10 enums (UserRole, OrderStatus, PaymentMethod, …).

blocks.text: Authentication flow: the user signs in to the Next.js frontend, the API route delegates to Supabase Auth and a session is stored; subsequent requests go through middleware and read session data (evidence: src/app/auth/callback, src/lib/session.ts, src/middleware.ts).

blocks.text: Public API surface observed (src/app/api): products, search, reviews, coupons/validate, orders, track-order, wishlist-related, newsletter, contact, config, upload, profile, and an /api/admin/* set (customers, orders, products, reviews, brands, coupons, categories, contact).
